summary.text: Josh Elliott has represented Connecticut's 88th House District, which includes Hamden, since winning the seat in 2016.

paragraphs.text: He grew up in Connecticut and attended high school in Hamden, then earned a B.A. in Sociology from Ithaca College and a J.D. from Quinnipiac School of Law.
He serves as Deputy Speaker and Majority Caucus Co-Chair, and is a member of the Finance, Revenue & Bonding, Public Health and Judiciary committees.
